Olam Agri is at the heart of global food and agri-trade flows with more than 40 million MT in volume traded annually. Focused on transforming food, feed and fiber for a more sustainable future, it aims at creating value for customers, enabling farming communities to prosper sustainably, and strive for a food-secure future.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: General Manager and Operations Head

Job Location: Iganmu, Lagos
Department: Corporate function
Business Information - Wheat Milling &amp; Pasta

Job Description


	The Operations Head in Olam Agri will be responsible for managing and optimizing end-to-end logistics operations, ensuring cost-efficient, timely, and reliable movement of goods.
	The role combines operational leadership with strategic planning to support business growth and service excellence.


Responsibilities


	This is a dual role for managing Inhouse Fleet Operation for the wheat milling business (the largest for any wheat miller in Africa with plans for doubling this number in the next 3years ) ,In addition to this the role also involves being part of the S&amp;OP process and support in monthly volume delivery for the business via 3rd party trucks.


Fleet Management:


	Deliver fleet KPIs on mileage, revenue/km, utilization, and profitability.
	Plan fleet capacity, optimize routes, and control fuel and maintenance costs.
	Ensure vehicle availability, safety, compliance, and driver performance.
	Leverage fleet technology and analytics to improve efficiency.
	Manage fleet procurement and inventory (spares, tyres, fuel) while developing vendor partnerships.

	Align logistics operations with business and S&amp;OP demand plans.
	Oversee transportation, warehousing, and distribution activities.
	Drive service excellence, cost optimization, and process improvements.
	Implement scalable logistics solutions to support business growth.


People Leadership:


	Lead, develop, and engage logistics and fleet teams.
	Support workforce planning, hiring, and capability building.


Stakeholder &amp; Vendor Management:


	Collaborate with internal stakeholders and business teams.
	Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and commercial negotiations for optimal cost and service outcomes.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	MBA from a top-tier institute (Sales, Marketing, Operations, or Agri-business preferred).
	8&ndash;10 years of post-MBA experience in logistics, operations, or supply chain roles.


Key Competencies:


	Strong commercial and profit-center orientation.
	Proven experience managing large teams and scaling operations.
	Excellent communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
	High ownership mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-paced environments.

General Manager and Operations Head Job at Olam Agri




        
    

        
        Olam Agri is a market-leading, differentiated food, feed, and fiber agri-business with a global origination footprint, processing capabilities, and deep understanding of market needs built over 33 years. With a strong presence in high-growth emerging markets and products across grains & oilseeds, animal feed & protein, rice, edible oils, specialty grains & seeds, cotton, wood products, rubber and commodity financial services.

Olam Agri is at the heart of global food and agri-trade flows with more than 40 million MT in volume traded annually. Focused on transforming food, feed and fiber for a more sustainable future, it aims at creating value for customers, enabling farming communities to prosper sustainably, and strive for a food-secure future.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: General Manager and Operations Head

Job Location: Iganmu, Lagos
Department: Corporate function
Business Information - Wheat Milling & Pasta

Job Description


	The Operations Head in Olam Agri will be responsible for managing and optimizing end-to-end logistics operations, ensuring cost-efficient, timely, and reliable movement of goods.
	The role combines operational leadership with strategic planning to support business growth and service excellence.


Responsibilities


	This is a dual role for managing Inhouse Fleet Operation for the wheat milling business (the largest for any wheat miller in Africa with plans for doubling this number in the next 3years ) ,In addition to this the role also involves being part of the S&OP process and support in monthly volume delivery for the business via 3rd party trucks.


Fleet Management:


	Deliver fleet KPIs on mileage, revenue/km, utilization, and profitability.
	Plan fleet capacity, optimize routes, and control fuel and maintenance costs.
	Ensure vehicle availability, safety, compliance, and driver performance.
	Leverage fleet technology and analytics to improve efficiency.
	Manage fleet procurement and inventory (spares, tyres, fuel) while developing vendor partnerships.


Logistics & Warehouse Management:


	Align logistics operations with business and S&OP demand plans.
	Oversee transportation, warehousing, and distribution activities.
	Drive service excellence, cost optimization, and process improvements.
	Implement scalable logistics solutions to support business growth.


People Leadership:


	Lead, develop, and engage logistics and fleet teams.
	Support workforce planning, hiring, and capability building.


Stakeholder & Vendor Management:


	Collaborate with internal stakeholders and business teams.
	Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and commercial negotiations for optimal cost and service outcomes.


Qualifications & Experience


	MBA from a top-tier institute (Sales, Marketing, Operations, or Agri-business preferred).
	8–10 years of post-MBA experience in logistics, operations, or supply chain roles.


Key Competencies:


	Strong commercial and profit-center orientation.
	Proven experience managing large teams and scaling operations.
	Excellent communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
	High ownership mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-paced environments.

Customer Satisfaction Representative Job at Diversay Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        Diversay Solutions Limited is a Nigerian company focused on animal health and livestock solutions. The company provides veterinary pharmaceuticals, laboratory services, equipment, biosecurity solutions, and technical support to farmers, veterinarians, and businesses in the livestock industry. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Satisfaction Representative

Job Location: Kano
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Customer Satisfaction Representative to join our team in Kano.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and respond promptly to enquiries and complaints.
	Build and maintain positive relationships with customers across the North-West region.
	Follow up with customers to ensure their needs and concerns are properly addressed.
	Collect and document customer feedback, complaints, and service issues.
	Work closely with the Sales and other relevant teams to resolve customer concerns.
	Monitor customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and follow-up activities.
	Support customer retention and contribute to a positive customer experience.
	Provide regular reports on customer feedback, complaints, and satisfaction levels.


Requirements


	HND / B.Sc.Degree in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Biological Sciences, Business Administration, Marketing, or related field.
	2–3 years of experience in customer service, veterinary/animal health, pharmaceutical, or related industries.
	Veterinary/animal health experience is an added advantage.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and customer relationship skills.
	Must be resident in Kano or willing to relocate

Terminal Operations Manager Job at GIG Mobility




        
    

        
        GIG Mobility (formerly God Is Good Motors) started in 1998 as a traditional family-run bus company in Nigeria. Following the tragic death of founders Edwin and Stella Ajaere, their son, Chidi Ajaere, took over in 2009. He transformed the company from a traditional transport business into a major tech-enabled mobility and logistics company. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Terminal Operations Manager

Job Locations: Benin, Auchi & Ekpoma - Edo, Warri - Delta and Bayelsa
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee the daily operations of the assigned terminal within a region, ensuring compliance with company standards and operational procedures.
	Lead, supervise, and support terminal employees to achieve operational excellence and business objectives.
	Ensure efficient fleet utilization, timely vehicle departures and arrivals, and effective coordination with the Fleet and Maintenance teams.
	Drive exceptional customer experience by maintaining service quality, resolving escalated customer issues, and implementing service improvement initiatives.
	Monitor regional operational performance, analyse key performance indicators (KPIs), and prepare periodic reports with actionable recommendations.
	Ensure compliance with safety regulations, transport laws, company policies, and operational risk management requirements.
	Manage regional operational budgets and resources effectively to optimize costs and improve profitability.
	Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Experience Officers, HR, Finance, Tech, and Maintenance, to support seamless business operations.
	Conduct regular terminal audits, identify operational gaps, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and productivity.


Method of Application

Restaurant Operative Job at Food Concepts Plc




        
    

        
        Food Concepts commenced operations in 2001. From inception, our aim has been clear-cut and focused: to revolutionize the food sector in West Africa and to deliver extraordinary satisfaction to our stakeholders.

Since launching in 2004, Chicken Republic (Subsidiary of Food concepts) has already opened 55 stores in Nigeria and Ghana. On this basis, we are proud of the brand’s hard-earned reputation as the fastest growing chicken QSR in West Africa and the number 1 chicken QSR in Nigeria (both in revenues and number of outlets). In addition, Chicken Republic was ranked as one of Nigeria’s top 20 brands across all categories (Financial Standards Awards 2009). 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Restaurant Operative

Job Location: VGC, Lagos

Responsibilities


	Take on domestic and operational tasks (Cook, Fryer, Cashier, Host) as assigned by the Restaurant Manager. 
	Work collaboratively with the team to ensure smooth daily operations. 
	Uphold all company policies and represent the brand positively.


Requirements


	SSCE / NABTEB / NCE / OND 
	0–1 year of experience in the QSR industry.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills 
	Physically fit with the stamina to stand for long hours 
	Reliable, smart, and proactive 
	Must reside on the island or nearby – *no accommodation provided*


Benefits


	Asides salary
	Breakfast while on duty 
	Pension & HMO.
	Free On-the-Job training to master your role with a teamwork culture.
	One day off per week with 6 days shift schedule.
	Expected to work during Public holidays.
	Leave Allowance & 13th Month Bonus 
	Earn the four training certifications and advance to a Skills Trainer level.

  "description": "Brands Optimal Limited is one of Africa&rsquo;s leading experiential marketing agencies, which optimizes value for clients through the use of strategic, reliable, and measurable methods in consumer engagement, loyalty seeding, and sales generation.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Internal Control Officer (Audit)&nbsp;&nbsp;

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Internal Control &amp; Field Assurance Officer will serve as the agency&rsquo;s primary line of defense against fraud, budget inflation, and campaign operational failures.
	You will enforce strict compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) during agency campaigns and identify financial leakage points across vendor management and project execution.


Key Responsibilities


	Forensic Auditing: Investigate budget overruns, vendor invoices, and project float retirement discrepancies.
	Live Spot Checks: Conduct unannounced field visits to activation sites to verify promoter compliance and asset deployment.
	Process Risk Mapping: Evaluate standard workflows across all departments to patch internal control vulnerabilities.
	Post-Activation Reconciliation: Audit and reconcile post-event project retirements, ensuring all receipts, field logs, and vendor invoices are genuine and accurate.
	Asset Tracking: Track the movement and storage of brand assets, rigs, electronics, and point-of-sale materials (POSMs) in the warehouse.
	Vendor Price Vetting: Periodically audit procurement processes and benchmark vendor quotes against market prices for setups, fabrications, printing, and merchandise.
	Corrective Action Planning: Work with heads of departments to correct audit exceptions and build stronger financial guardrails.
	Vendor Price Vetting: Periodically audit procurement processes and benchmark vendor quotes against market prices for setups, fabrications, printing, and merchandise.
	Exception Reporting: Maintain a weekly audit exception tracker and report all control breaches, financial errors, or suspicious activities directly to Management


Requirements &amp; Qualifications


	Education: B.Sc. / HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related business discipline.
	Experience: 3 to 4 years of proven experience in Internal Control, Internal Audit, or Compliance (experience in an agency, media firm, or FMCG environment is highly valued).
	Professional Stage: ACA / ACCA qualified, or currently in the final professional stages.
	Technical Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables) and accounting software/ERP systems.


Method of Application&nbsp;

Internal Control Officer (Audit) Job at Brands Optimal Limited




        
    

        
        Brands Optimal Limited is one of Africa’s leading experiential marketing agencies, which optimizes value for clients through the use of strategic, reliable, and measurable methods in consumer engagement, loyalty seeding, and sales generation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Internal Control Officer (Audit)  

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Internal Control & Field Assurance Officer will serve as the agency’s primary line of defense against fraud, budget inflation, and campaign operational failures.
	You will enforce strict compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) during agency campaigns and identify financial leakage points across vendor management and project execution.


Key Responsibilities


	Forensic Auditing: Investigate budget overruns, vendor invoices, and project float retirement discrepancies.
	Live Spot Checks: Conduct unannounced field visits to activation sites to verify promoter compliance and asset deployment.
	Process Risk Mapping: Evaluate standard workflows across all departments to patch internal control vulnerabilities.
	Post-Activation Reconciliation: Audit and reconcile post-event project retirements, ensuring all receipts, field logs, and vendor invoices are genuine and accurate.
	Asset Tracking: Track the movement and storage of brand assets, rigs, electronics, and point-of-sale materials (POSMs) in the warehouse.
	Vendor Price Vetting: Periodically audit procurement processes and benchmark vendor quotes against market prices for setups, fabrications, printing, and merchandise.
	Corrective Action Planning: Work with heads of departments to correct audit exceptions and build stronger financial guardrails.
	Vendor Price Vetting: Periodically audit procurement processes and benchmark vendor quotes against market prices for setups, fabrications, printing, and merchandise.
	Exception Reporting: Maintain a weekly audit exception tracker and report all control breaches, financial errors, or suspicious activities directly to Management


Requirements & Qualifications


	Education: B.Sc. / HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related business discipline.
	Experience: 3 to 4 years of proven experience in Internal Control, Internal Audit, or Compliance (experience in an agency, media firm, or FMCG environment is highly valued).
	Professional Stage: ACA / ACCA qualified, or currently in the final professional stages.
	Technical Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables) and accounting software/ERP systems.
